title: Create Pad
params.pad: Pad shape. This parameter is required before the special pad shape is implemented
params.holeRotation: Rotation angle of the hole relative to the pad
params.metallization: Whether the hole wall is plated
params.specialPad: Special pad shape. Currently not implemented; please do not use it
params.solderMaskAndPasteMaskExpansion: Solder mask/paste mask expansion. `null` means following the rules
